Embedded Software Intern
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated, passionate, and tech-savvy Embedded Software Intern
to join our R&D Engineering team through our campus hiring program. In this role, you will
gain hands-on experience working on real-world embedded systems, bridging the gap
between hardware and software. You will work closely with senior mentors to develop, test,
and debug low-level firmware that powers our next-generation products.
Key Responsibilities
 Firmware Development: Assist in designing, writing, and documenting clean, efficient
code in C/C++ for microcontrollers and microprocessors.
 Peripheral Interfacing: Learn and implement low-level drivers to interface
microcontrollers with sensors, actuators, and communication modules using UART, SPI,
I2C, or CAN protocols.
 Testing & Debugging: Utilize Oscilloscopes, Digital Multimeters, Logic Analyzers, and
JTAG/SWD Debuggers to troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues.
 Hardware Bring-up: Participate in initial board bring-up activities and validate
hardware functionality against schematic designs.
 Documentation: Maintain code documentation, testing procedures, and technical
requirement specifications.
 Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, scrum meetings, and cross-functional
sessions with Hardware and QA teams.
Required Skills & Qualifications
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in ECE, EE, CSE, or related technical
disciplines.
 Programming: Strong knowledge of Embedded C/C++. Knowledge of Python for
scripting/testing is an advantage.
 Microcontrollers: Academic or project experience with ARM Cortex-M, STM32, ESP32,
Arduino, or TI MSP430.
 Core Concepts: Understanding of Operating Systems, ISRs, Timers, and Memory
Management.
 Hardware Familiarity: Ability to read basic hardware schematics and component
datasheets.
 Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, eagerness to learn, and effective communication
skills.
Preferred / Bonus Qualifications
• F

Job Description – Battery Design
Engineering Intern
Position: Battery Design Engineering Intern
Department: R&D – Battery Engineering
Location: Mohan Estate, Delhi (or as applicable)
Duration: 6 Months
Reports To: Battery Design Lead / Engineering Manager
Role Summary
We are looking for a passionate and motivated Battery Design Engineering Intern to support the
development of lithium-ion battery packs for electric vehicles. The intern will work closely with
the Battery Engineering team and gain hands-on exposure to battery pack design, CAD
modeling, validation activities, and product development processes.
Key Responsibilities
Battery Pack Design Support
 Assist in developing 3D CAD models and 2D drawings for battery pack components.
 Support the design of battery enclosures, brackets, cell holders, and structural parts.
 Help create engineering drawings and maintain design documentation.
Engineering & Analysis
 Support basic tolerance stack-up studies and design evaluations.
 Assist in reviewing CAD models for manufacturability and assembly.
 Work with the engineering team on design improvements based on test results.
Testing & Validation Support
 Assist in battery pack testing activities such as thermal, vibration, and environmental
tests.
 Help collect, organize, and analyze test data.
 Support documentation of validation reports and observations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
 Coordinate with Battery, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Quality teams for project
activities.
 Support prototype build activities and design reviews.
Required Qualifications
 Pursuing or recently completed B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive
Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines.
 Basic understanding of electric vehicle battery systems and lithium-ion technology.
 Strong interest in EVs and battery pack development.
Technical Skills
 Basic knowledge of CAD tools such as CATIA V5, SolidWorks, Creo, or NX.
 Understanding of engineering dra

Embedded Software Intern
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated, passionate, and tech-savvy Embedded Software Intern
to join our R&D Engineering team through our campus hiring program. In this role, you will
gain hands-on experience working on real-world embedded systems, bridging the gap
between hardware and software. You will work closely with senior mentors to develop, test,
and debug low-level firmware that powers our next-generation products.
Key Responsibilities
 Firmware Development: Assist in designing, writing, and documenting clean, efficient
code in C/C++ for microcontrollers and microprocessors.
 Peripheral Interfacing: Learn and implement low-level drivers to interface
microcontrollers with sensors, actuators, and communication modules using UART, SPI,
I2C, or CAN protocols.
 Testing & Debugging: Utilize Oscilloscopes, Digital Multimeters, Logic Analyzers, and
JTAG/SWD Debuggers to troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues.
 Hardware Bring-up: Participate in initial board bring-up activities and validate
hardware functionality against schematic designs.
 Documentation: Maintain code documentation, testing procedures, and technical
requirement specifications.
 Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, scrum meetings, and cross-functional
sessions with Hardware and QA teams.
Required Skills & Qualifications
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in ECE, EE, CSE, or related technical
disciplines.
 Programming: Strong knowledge of Embedded C/C++. Knowledge of Python for
scripting/testing is an advantage.
 Microcontrollers: Academic or project experience with ARM Cortex-M, STM32, ESP32,
Arduino, or TI MSP430.
 Core Concepts: Understanding of Operating Systems, ISRs, Timers, and Memory
Management.
 Hardware Familiarity: Ability to read basic hardware schematics and component
datasheets.
 Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, eagerness to learn, and effective communication
skills.
Preferred / Bonus Qualifications
• F

integration.

with regulatory requirements.
 Perform simulation and analysis of electrical and electronic circuits for validation and
testing.

components and harnesses.

(BMS), Vehicle Control Units (VCU), Electronic Control Units (ECUs) chargers, DC-DC

 Support development of automotive and EV electronic systems.
 Preparing test code for the executing Test cases on Hardware.
 Prepare test reports and documentation.
Requirements
 Pursuing B.E./B. Tech in ECE (preferred), EE, E&I, Mechatronics, or related fields.
 Good understanding of Analog & Digital Electronics.
 Basic knowledge of Embedded Systems and Microcontrollers.
 Familiarity with CAN communication and PCB design tools is a plus.
 Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Preferred
 Hands-on experience with STM32, Arduino, ESP32, or similar platforms.
 Participation in EV, Formula Students, Robotics, or embedded projects.

Job Description Electrical Engineer
Location–DelhiNCR
Euler Motors, founded in 2018, is an OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specializing in
electric vehicles for commercial applications. The company is committed to delivering high-
quality products that integrate the latest advancements in engineering and technology.
With a focus on innovation, Euler Motors aims to develop advanced electric vehicles that offer
exceptional performance and reliability. Described as “intelligent computers running on
wheels,” these vehicles go beyond transportation — they are smart systems capable of
collecting, processing, and analyzing data to provide real-time insights into vehicle performance
and operations.
About the Role:
Euler Motors is at the forefront of revolutionizing Electric Vehicle (EV) technology, and we are
seeking a skilled Electrical Engineer to join our dynamic team.
As an Electrical Engineer, you will play a crucial role in shaping the electrical architecture of
our cutting-edge electric vehicles.
JOB DESCRIPITION
Wire Harness Design and Development
 Design and develop 2D schematics and perform 3D routing for LV and HV wire harness
systems.
 Select appropriate electrical components including fuses, relays, connectors, wires, and
contactors as per schematic and safety standards.
 Collaborate on vehicle electrical architecture to support advanced EV system
integration.
 Ensure all designs meet automotive wiring standards (ISO-6722) and are compliant
with regulatory requirements.
 Perform simulation and analysis of electrical and electronic circuits for validation and
testing.
DVP – Electrical Systems
 Develop and manage DVP&R (Design Validation Plan and Report) for electrical
components and harnesses.

Job Description – Battery Design
Engineering Intern
Position: Battery Design Engineering Intern
Department: R&D – Battery Engineering
Location: Mohan Estate, Delhi (or as applicable)
Duration: 6 Months
Reports To: Battery Design Lead / Engineering Manager
Role Summary
We are looking for a passionate and motivated Battery Design Engineering Intern to support the
development of lithium-ion battery packs for electric vehicles. The intern will work closely with
the Battery Engineering team and gain hands-on exposure to battery pack design, CAD
modeling, validation activities, and product development processes.
Key Responsibilities
Battery Pack Design Support
 Assist in developing 3D CAD models and 2D drawings for battery pack components.
 Support the design of battery enclosures, brackets, cell holders, and structural parts.
 Help create engineering drawings and maintain design documentation.
Engineering & Analysis
 Support basic tolerance stack-up studies and design evaluations.
 Assist in reviewing CAD models for manufacturability and assembly.
 Work with the engineering team on design improvements based on test results.
Testing & Validation Support
 Assist in battery pack testing activities such as thermal, vibration, and environmental
tests.

forensics.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst/Data
Scientist with a strong foundation in Analytics or Data Science, excellent
programming skills in Python and SQL, and a solid understanding of Data
Modelling and Data Warehousing concepts. The ideal candidate will work closely with
cross-functional teams to transform data into actionable insights and support data-
driven decision-making.
Key Responsibilities:
• Design and implement data pipelines using Python and SQL.
• Develop and maintain data models to support business intelligence and
analytics.
• Work with large datasets to extract, clean, and analyze data for reporting and
insights.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver
solutions.
• Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to solve business problems.
• Ensure data quality, integrity, and governance across systems.
Required Skills:
• Postgraduate degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science,
or a related field.
• Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and automation.
• Strong command of SQL for querying and managing relational databases.
• Good understanding of Data Modelling (star/snowflake schemas, normalization).
• Familiarity with Data Warehousing concepts and tools (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift,
BigQuery).
• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
Preferred Qualifications:
AXA - GBS Public
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and data pipeline tools (e.g.,
Airflow, dbt).
• Knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and best practices.
• Exposure to version control systems like Git.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Education:
• Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
AXA - GBS Public
--- END OF DOCUMENT ---

Department: R&D – Battery Engineering

tests.

 Coordinate with Battery, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Quality teams for project

Job Description – Battery Design
Engineering Intern
Position: Battery Design Engineering Intern
Department: R&D – Battery Engineering
Location: Mohan Estate, Delhi (or as applicable)
Duration: 6 Months
Reports To: Battery Design Lead / Engineering Manager
Role Summary
We are looking for a passionate and motivated Battery Design Engineering Intern to support the
development of lithium-ion battery packs for electric vehicles. The intern will work closely with
the Battery Engineering team and gain hands-on exposure to battery pack design, CAD
modeling, validation activities, and product development processes.
Key Responsibilities
Battery Pack Design Support
 Assist in developing 3D CAD models and 2D drawings for battery pack components.
 Support the design of battery enclosures, brackets, cell holders, and structural parts.
 Help create engineering drawings and maintain design documentation.
Engineering & Analysis
 Support basic tolerance stack-up studies and design evaluations.
 Assist in reviewing CAD models for manufacturability and assembly.
 Work with the engineering team on design improvements based on test results.
Testing & Validation Support
 Assist in battery pack testing activities such as thermal, vibration, and environmental
tests.
 Help collect, organize, and analyze test data.
 Support documentation of validation reports and observations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
 Coordinate with Battery, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Quality teams for project
activities.
 Support prototype build activities and design reviews.
Required Qualifications
 Pursuing or recently completed B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive
Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines.
 Basic understanding of electric vehicle battery systems and lithium-ion technology.
 Strong interest in EVs and battery pack development.
Technical Skills
 Basic knowledge of CAD tools such as CATIA V5, SolidWorks, Creo, or NX.
 Understanding of engineering dra

and contact center solutions based on its powerful Message Video Phone™ (MVP™)
platform. More flexible and cost effective than legacy on-premise PBX and video
conferencing systems that it replaces, RingCentral empowers modern mobile and
distributed workforces to communicate, collaborate, and connect via any mode, any
device, and any location. RingCentral offers three key products in its portfolio including
RingCentral Office® , a Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS) platform including
team messaging, video meetings, and a cloud phone system; Glip ® the company's free
video meetings solution with team messaging that enables Smart Video Meetings™; and
RingCentral cloud Contact Center solutions. RingCentral’s open platform integrates with
leading third party business applications and enables customers to easily customize
business workflows.

scalable systems and features to meet the business objectives. You will own one or many
micro-service components or functional areas and work across multiple engineering
teams in both consultative and embedded roles to ensure the successful delivery of new
products.

Sabre is a technology solutions provider to the global travel and tourism industry. We offer a broad range
of technology solutions including, data-driven business intelligence, mobile, distribution and Software as
a Service solutions which are used by travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, car rental outlets, railways, and
tour operators) and travel buyers (travel agencies, travel management companies and corporate travel
departments) to plan, market, sell, serve and operate their business.
Headquartered in Southlake, Texas, USA, Sabre employs approximately 3,700 people in approximately
60 countries around the world.
As a leading software and technology innovator for over 60 years, we partner with airlines, hoteliers and
agencies to make travel happen around the world. We’re constantly working to develop the next cutting-
edge technology solution and looking for inspired, curious and innovative people to join our team – is that
you? If so, Let’s get going
Designation: AI Engineer
Role Overview
Welcome to the future of software engineering. We don’t just write code; we orchestrate it. As an
engineer in our AI-Enabled SDLC Smart Squad, you won't be stuck copy-pasting boilerplate code or
“vibe coding”. Instead, you will act as a co-pilot, working alongside senior developers (Orchestrators)
and advanced AI coding agents to build, test, and deploy enterprise-grade software at hyper-speed.
This role is designed for fresh graduates who want to skip legacy development habits and master the
next generation of software engineering: Agentic workflows, rigorous test-driven validation, and AI code
forensics.
Core Responsibilities (The Agentic SDLC)
Co-Piloting the Agent Execution Loop
• The Mission: Transform well-defined technical specs assigned by Senior Orchestrators (e.g.,
building React UI layouts, defining microservice endpoint or a machine learning pipeline
component) to operational building block of features that redefine travel industry.
• The Execution: Instead of coding

Aumovio is a global automotive technology leader specializing in safe, connected, and
autonomous mobility solutions. As a premier standalone powerhouse steering next-
generation vehicle electronics and architectures, we offer a dynamic environment for young
engineering minds to work on cutting-edge industry applications.
Role Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated and technically sound M.Tech Intern to join our WBS
ME Simulation Team in Bangalore. This internship offers hands-on experience in
automotive engineering simulations, working alongside industry experts to validate and
optimize complex mechanical systems.
Position: Graduate Engineer Intern (Mechanical Simulation)
Target Batch: Current M.Tech students 2027 available for immediate internship
Location: Bangalore, India
Key Responsibilities
Assist the WBS ME Simulation team in executing mechanical engineering simulations and
finite element analyses (FEA).
Build, mesh, and set up virtual simulation models for automotive components and
subsystems.
Analyze simulation results, identify design bottlenecks, and present technical findings to the
core engineering group.
Collaborate cross-functionally to support product development, design optimization, and
validation workflows.
Maintain rigorous documentation of simulation iterations, parameters, and design outcomes.
Technical Skills:
Strong fundamental knowledge of mechanical engineering core principles (Structures,
Dynamics, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics).
Familiarity with industry-standard CAE/Simulation tools (e.g., Ansys, Abaqus, HyperMesh, or
similar simulation suites) is highly preferred.
Basic understanding of 3D CAD modeling software.
--- END OF DOCUMENT ---

rubric_evidence: Provides a correct and reasonably detailed explanation of FEA, including the element division concept and its application to stress/strain analysis.
Recognizes the trade-off between accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating an understanding of practical considerations.
The example of a bridge design tool is relevant and clearly explained.
question: What is Finite Element Analysis, and can you give an example of how it might be used in a simple software application?

Job Description Electrical Engineer
Location–DelhiNCR
Euler Motors, founded in 2018, is an OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specializing in
electric vehicles for commercial applications. The company is committed to delivering high-
quality products that integrate the latest advancements in engineering and technology.
With a focus on innovation, Euler Motors aims to develop advanced electric vehicles that offer
exceptional performance and reliability. Described as “intelligent computers running on
wheels,” these vehicles go beyond transportation — they are smart systems capable of
collecting, processing, and analyzing data to provide real-time insights into vehicle performance
and operations.
About the Role:
Euler Motors is at the forefront of revolutionizing Electric Vehicle (EV) technology, and we are
seeking a skilled Electrical Engineer to join our dynamic team.
As an Electrical Engineer, you will play a crucial role in shaping the electrical architecture of
our cutting-edge electric vehicles.
JOB DESCRIPITION
Wire Harness Design and Development
 Design and develop 2D schematics and perform 3D routing for LV and HV wire harness
systems.
 Select appropriate electrical components including fuses, relays, connectors, wires, and
contactors as per schematic and safety standards.
 Collaborate on vehicle electrical architecture to support advanced EV system
integration.
 Ensure all designs meet automotive wiring standards (ISO-6722) and are compliant
with regulatory requirements.
 Perform simulation and analysis of electrical and electronic circuits for validation and
testing.
DVP – Electrical Systems
 Develop and manage DVP&R (Design Validation Plan and Report) for electrical
components and harnesses.
 Coordinate and execute bench, lab, and vehicle-level tests.
 Work with cross-functional teams to analyze test data and resolve issues.
 Ensure validation is aligned with automotive standards (AIS, ISO, etc.).
 Prepare and maintain test reports and document

rubric_evidence: The answer demonstrates a fundamental misunderstanding of schematics and provides only very basic, almost trivial knowledge.
question: Can you describe your experience creating and reading 2D schematics for electronic circuits?

and contact center solutions based on its powerful Message Video Phone™ (MVP™)
platform. More flexible and cost effective than legacy on-premise PBX and video
conferencing systems that it replaces, RingCentral empowers modern mobile and
distributed workforces to communicate, collaborate, and connect via any mode, any
device, and any location. RingCentral offers three key products in its portfolio including
RingCentral Office® , a Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS) platform including
team messaging, video meetings, and a cloud phone system; Glip ® the company's free
video meetings solution with team messaging that enables Smart Video Meetings™; and
RingCentral cloud Contact Center solutions. RingCentral’s open platform integrates with
leading third party business applications and enables customers to easily customize
business workflows.
Software Development Engineer.
As part of our Innovation/Engineering team, Software engineers will work with
architects, product management and other engineering teams to understand the product
roadmap and requirements, responsible for designing and implementation of reliable and
scalable systems and features to meet the business objectives. You will own one or many
micro-service components or functional areas and work across multiple engineering
teams in both consultative and embedded roles to ensure the successful delivery of new
products.

● Review and understand requirements along with product
management and team, work with other engineers in the team to

 Pursuing or recently completed B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive

 Develop and execute validation test plans for PMSM (Part & System Level).
 Perform and assist the testing team on performance testing including torque-speed, efficiency,

conditions.

 Support root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions.
 Work closely with design and testing teams for continuous improvements.
 Document test procedures, results, and validation reports systematically.

Added Advantage:
 Awareness of industry standards (IEC, ISO and automotive standards).

to join our R&D Engineering team through our campus hiring program. In this role, you will
gain hands-on experience working on real-world embedded systems, bridging the gap
between hardware and software. You will work closely with senior mentors to develop, test,
and debug low-level firmware that powers our next-generation products.
Key Responsibilities
 Firmware Development: Assist in designing, writing, and documenting clean, efficient
code in C/C++ for microcontrollers and microprocessors.
 Peripheral Interfacing: Learn and implement low-level drivers to interface
microcontrollers with sensors, actuators, and communication modules using UART, SPI,
I2C, or CAN protocols.
 Testing & Debugging: Utilize Oscilloscopes, Digital Multimeters, Logic Analyzers, and
JTAG/SWD Debuggers to troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues.
 Hardware Bring-up: Participate in initial board bring-up activities and validate
hardware functionality against schematic designs.
 Documentation: Maintain code documentation, testing procedures, and technical
requirement specifications.
 Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, scrum meetings, and cross-functional
sessions with Hardware and QA teams.
Required Skills & Qualifications
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in ECE, EE, CSE, or related technical
disciplines.
 Programming: Strong knowledge of Embedded C/C++. Knowledge of Python for
scripting/testing is an advantage.
 Microcontrollers: Academic or project experience with ARM Cortex-M, STM32, ESP32,
Arduino, or TI MSP430.
 Core Concepts: Understanding of Operating Systems, ISRs, Timers, and Memory
Management.
 Hardware Familiarity: Ability to read basic hardware schematics and component
datasheets.
 Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, eagerness to learn, and effective communication
skills.
Preferred / Bonus Qualifications
• F

Job Description – Battery Design
Engineering Intern
Position: Battery Design Engineering Intern
Department: R&D – Battery Engineering
Location: Mohan Estate, Delhi (or as applicable)
Duration: 6 Months
Reports To: Battery Design Lead / Engineering Manager
Role Summary
We are looking for a passionate and motivated Battery Design Engineering Intern to support the
development of lithium-ion battery packs for electric vehicles. The intern will work closely with
the Battery Engineering team and gain hands-on exposure to battery pack design, CAD
modeling, validation activities, and product development processes.
Key Responsibilities
Battery Pack Design Support
 Assist in developing 3D CAD models and 2D drawings for battery pack components.
 Support the design of battery enclosures, brackets, cell holders, and structural parts.
 Help create engineering drawings and maintain design documentation.
Engineering & Analysis
 Support basic tolerance stack-up studies and design evaluations.
 Assist in reviewing CAD models for manufacturability and assembly.
 Work with the engineering team on design improvements based on test results.
Testing & Validation Support
 Assist in battery pack testing activities such as thermal, vibration, and environmental
tests.
 Help collect, organize, and analyze test data.
 Support documentation of validation reports and observations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
 Coordinate with Battery, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Quality teams for project
activities.
 Support prototype build activities and design reviews.
Required Qualifications
 Pursuing or recently completed B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive
Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines.
 Basic understanding of electric vehicle battery systems and lithium-ion technology.
 Strong interest in EVs and battery pack development.
Technical Skills
 Basic knowledge of CAD tools such as CATIA V5, SolidWorks, Creo, or NX.

ME Simulation Team in Bangalore. This internship offers hands-on experience in
automotive engineering simulations, working alongside industry experts to validate and
optimize complex mechanical systems.

Assist the WBS ME Simulation team in executing mechanical engineering simulations and

Analyze simulation results, identify design bottlenecks, and present technical findings to the
core engineering group.
Collaborate cross-functionally to support product development, design optimization, and
validation workflows.
Maintain rigorous documentation of simulation iterations, parameters, and design outcomes.
Technical Skills:
Strong fundamental knowledge of mechanical engineering core principles (Structures,
Dynamics, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics).
Familiarity with industry-standard CAE/Simulation tools (e.g., Ansys, Abaqus, HyperMesh, or

Basic understanding of 3D CAD modeling software.

Job Title: Motor Controller Application Engineer
Department: Powertrain / Technology
Job Summary:-
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Motor Controller Application Engineer to join our
Electric Vehicle development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for integration,
calibration, and validation of motor controllers across various EV platforms. This role requires
deep technical understanding of motor control algorithms, CAN communication, and real-world
vehicle application tuning.
Key Responsibilities:
 Lead the integration and validation of motor controllers with vehicle systems.
 Work closely with firmware, electrical, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless
system compatibility.
 Define and calibrate motor control parameters for optimal performance, efficiency, and
thermal management.
 Interface with controller suppliers for software customization, bug resolution, and feature
upgrades.
 Conduct vehicle-level testing and tuning for different drive modes (Eco, Sport, Regen,
etc.).
 Analyze CAN logs and develop automated scripts for performance evaluation and
debugging.
 Support in development of power maps, torque curves, and regen profiles as per vehicle
requirement.
 Validate motor control functions under various road and load conditions.
 Assist in defining functional safety and diagnostic requirements in compliance with ISO
26262.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support homologation and regulatory testing.
Required Skills & Qualifications:-
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechatronics Engineering.
 relevant college experience in motor control systems (BLDC / PMSM / SRM).
 Strong understanding of motor control theory, field-oriented control (FOC), sensor
calibration, and tuning.
 Experience with CAN tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, PCAN) and CAN protocol
analysis.
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or similar tools for data processing and
parameter tuning.
 Familiarity with veh

jd_text:
Job Title: Motor Controller Application Engineer
Department: Powertrain / Technology
Job Summary:-
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Motor Controller Application Engineer to join our
Electric Vehicle development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for integration,
calibration, and validation of motor controllers across various EV platforms. This role requires
deep technical understanding of motor control algorithms, CAN communication, and real-world
vehicle application tuning.
Key Responsibilities:
 Lead the integration and validation of motor controllers with vehicle systems.
 Work closely with firmware, electrical, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless
system compatibility.
 Define and calibrate motor control parameters for optimal performance, efficiency, and
thermal management.
 Interface with controller suppliers for software customization, bug resolution, and feature
upgrades.
 Conduct vehicle-level testing and tuning for different drive modes (Eco, Sport, Regen,
etc.).
 Analyze CAN logs and develop automated scripts for performance evaluation and
debugging.
 Support in development of power maps, torque curves, and regen profiles as per vehicle
requirement.
 Validate motor control functions under various road and load conditions.
 Assist in defining functional safety and diagnostic requirements in compliance with ISO
26262.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support homologation and regulatory testing.
Required Skills & Qualifications:-
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechatronics Engineering.
 relevant college experience in motor control systems (BLDC / PMSM / SRM).
 Strong understanding of motor control theory, field-oriented control (FOC), sensor
calibration, and tuning.
 Experience with CAN tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, PCAN) and CAN protocol
analysis.
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or similar tools for data processing and
parameter tuning.
 Familiarity with veh

Job Title: Motor Controller Application Engineer
Department: Powertrain / Technology
Job Summary:-
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Motor Controller Application Engineer to join our
Electric Vehicle development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for integration,
calibration, and validation of motor controllers across various EV platforms. This role requires
deep technical understanding of motor control algorithms, CAN communication, and real-world
vehicle application tuning.
Key Responsibilities:
 Lead the integration and validation of motor controllers with vehicle systems.
 Work closely with firmware, electrical, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless
system compatibility.
 Define and calibrate motor control parameters for optimal performance, efficiency, and
thermal management.
 Interface with controller suppliers for software customization, bug resolution, and feature
upgrades.
 Conduct vehicle-level testing and tuning for different drive modes (Eco, Sport, Regen,
etc.).
 Analyze CAN logs and develop automated scripts for performance evaluation and
debugging.
 Support in development of power maps, torque curves, and regen profiles as per vehicle
requirement.
 Validate motor control functions under various road and load conditions.
 Assist in defining functional safety and diagnostic requirements in compliance with ISO
26262.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support homologation and regulatory testing.
Required Skills & Qualifications:-
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechatronics Engineering.
 relevant college experience in motor control systems (BLDC / PMSM / SRM).
 Strong understanding of motor control theory, field-oriented control (FOC), sensor
calibration, and tuning.
 Experience with CAN tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, PCAN) and CAN protocol
analysis.
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or similar tools for data processing and
parameter tuning.
 Familiarity with veh

Job Title: Motor Controller Application Engineer
Department: Powertrain / Technology
Job Summary:-
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Motor Controller Application Engineer to join our
Electric Vehicle development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for integration,
calibration, and validation of motor controllers across various EV platforms. This role requires
deep technical understanding of motor control algorithms, CAN communication, and real-world
vehicle application tuning.
Key Responsibilities:
 Lead the integration and validation of motor controllers with vehicle systems.
 Work closely with firmware, electrical, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless
system compatibility.
 Define and calibrate motor control parameters for optimal performance, efficiency, and
thermal management.

upgrades.

etc.).
 Analyze CAN logs and develop automated scripts for performance evaluation and
debugging.
 Support in development of power maps, torque curves, and regen profiles as per vehicle
requirement.
 Validate motor control functions under various road and load conditions.
 Assist in defining functional safety and diagnostic requirements in compliance with ISO
26262.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support homologation and regulatory testing.
Required Skills & Qualifications:-
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechatronics Engineering.
 relevant college experience in motor control systems (BLDC / PMSM / SRM).
 Strong understanding of motor control theory, field-oriented control (FOC), sensor
calibration, and tuning.
 Experience with CAN tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, PCAN) and CAN protocol
analysis.
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or similar tools for data processing and
parameter tuning.
 Familiarity with veh

Job Title: Motor Controller Application Engineer
Department: Powertrain / Technology
Job Summary:-
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Motor Controller Application Engineer to join our
Electric Vehicle development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for integration,
calibration, and validation of motor controllers across various EV platforms. This role requires
deep technical understanding of motor control algorithms, CAN communication, and real-world
vehicle application tuning.
Key Responsibilities:
 Lead the integration and validation of motor controllers with vehicle systems.
 Work closely with firmware, electrical, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless
system compatibility.
 Define and calibrate motor control parameters for optimal performance, efficiency, and
thermal management.
 Interface with controller suppliers for software customization, bug resolution, and feature
upgrades.
 Conduct vehicle-level testing and tuning for different drive modes (Eco, Sport, Regen,
etc.).
 Analyze CAN logs and develop automated scripts for performance evaluation and
debugging.
 Support in development of power maps, torque curves, and regen profiles as per vehicle
requirement.
 Validate motor control functions under various road and load conditions.
 Assist in defining functional safety and diagnostic requirements in compliance with ISO
26262.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support homologation and regulatory testing.
Required Skills & Qualifications:-
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechatronics Engineering.
 relevant college experience in motor control systems (BLDC / PMSM / SRM).
 Strong understanding of motor control theory, field-oriented control (FOC), sensor
calibration, and tuning.
 Experience with CAN tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, PCAN) and CAN protocol
analysis.
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or similar tools for data processing and
parameter tuning.
 Familiarity with veh

Job Title: Motor Controller Application Engineer
Department: Powertrain / Technology
Job Summary:-
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Motor Controller Application Engineer to join our
Electric Vehicle development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for integration,
calibration, and validation of motor controllers across various EV platforms. This role requires
deep technical understanding of motor control algorithms, CAN communication, and real-world
vehicle application tuning.
Key Responsibilities:
 Lead the integration and validation of motor controllers with vehicle systems.
 Work closely with firmware, electrical, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless
system compatibility.
 Define and calibrate motor control parameters for optimal performance, efficiency, and
thermal management.
 Interface with controller suppliers for software customization, bug resolution, and feature
upgrades.
 Conduct vehicle-level testing and tuning for different drive modes (Eco, Sport, Regen,
etc.).
 Analyze CAN logs and develop automated scripts for performance evaluation and
debugging.
 Support in development of power maps, torque curves, and regen profiles as per vehicle
requirement.
 Validate motor control functions under various road and load conditions.
 Assist in defining functional safety and diagnostic requirements in compliance with ISO
26262.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support homologation and regulatory testing.
Required Skills & Qualifications:-
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechatronics Engineering.
 relevant college experience in motor control systems (BLDC / PMSM / SRM).
 Strong understanding of motor control theory, field-oriented control (FOC), sensor
calibration, and tuning.
 Experience with CAN tools (e.g., Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, PCAN) and CAN protocol
analysis.
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or similar tools for data processing and
parameter tuning.
 Familiarity with veh

jd_text:
Job Title: Validation Engineer - Motor
Department: Technology
Responsibilities & Must have:
 Develop and execute validation test plans for PMSM (Part & System Level).
 Perform and assist the testing team on performance testing including torque-speed, efficiency,
and power measurements.
 Conduct thermal analysis and validate motor behavior under continuous and peak load
conditions.
 Carry out endurance and reliability testing such as life cycle and thermal cycling tests.
 Analyze test data and prepare detailed validation and performance reports.
 Validate motor performance against design specifications and technical requirements.
 Identify issues such as overheating, vibration, noise, and losses.
 Support root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions.
 Work closely with design and testing teams for continuous improvements.
 Document test procedures, results, and validation reports systematically.
 Assist in DFMEA / PFMEA and continuous product improvement activities.
Added Advantage:
 Awareness of industry standards (IEC, ISO and automotive standards).
--- END OF DOCUMENT ---

rubric_evidence: Provides a reasonable and practical approach to implementing corrective actions based on DFMEA prioritization.  Considers relevant factors like cost, time, and impact. Includes a good example of a failure mode (system crashes under load) and a suitable corrective measure (load balancing and failover), demonstrating an understanding of trade-offs.  The circuit breaker pattern example is relevant and shows awareness of operational considerations.
question: How would you go about implementing corrective actions for a failure mode identified in a DFMEA, and what factors would you consider in choosing the appropriate corrective measures?
